details: picklescan before 0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions in the scope for its vulnerability scan. An attacker could craft a malicious model that uses Pickle and include a malicious pickle file with a non-standard file extension. Because the malicious pickle file inclusion is not considered as part of the scope of picklescan, the file would pass security checks and appear to be safe, when it could instead prove to be problematic.

A vulnerability in the GraphCypherQAChain class of langchain-ai/langchain-community version 0.2.5 allows for SQL injection through prompt injection. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data manipulation, data exfiltration, denial of service (DoS) by deleting all data, breaches in multi-tenant security environments, and data integrity issues. Attackers can create, update, or delete nodes and relationships without proper authorization, extract sensitive data, disrupt services, access data across different tenants, and compromise the integrity of the database.

descriptions.value: In DragonFly BSD through 6.4.2 before 4bb22ff, the ARP input handlers arpintr() and in_arpinput() (sys/netinet/if_ether.c) do not validate the hardware address length (ar_hln) and protocol address length (ar_pln) fields of incoming ARP packets. in_arpreply() then uses these attacker-controlled values as memcpy lengths when copying from kernel buffers that are only 6 and 4 bytes long, resulting in an out-of-bounds read of kernel heap and stack memory that is copied into the ARP reply sent back to the requester. An unauthenticated attacker on the adjacent network can use a single crafted ARP request to disclose up to roughly 250 bytes of each type of kernel memory, including kernel pointers. This is expected to be fixed in the 6.6 stable release when that is available.

descriptions.description: CWE-130 Improper Handling of Length Parameter Inconsistency

supportingMedia.value: Update to DragonFly BSD 6.6 once released (the maintainers have confirmed the fix will be included), or apply commit 4bb22ffcf2e9fb44995fbfd9945194afc87fb182 from master, which rejects ARP packets whose ar_hln is not ETHER_ADDR_LEN in arpintr() and whose ar_pln is not sizeof(struct in_addr) in in_arpinput().

solutions.value: Update to DragonFly BSD 6.6 once released (the maintainers have confirmed the fix will be included), or apply commit 4bb22ffcf2e9fb44995fbfd9945194afc87fb182 from master, which rejects ARP packets whose ar_hln is not ETHER_ADDR_LEN in arpintr() and whose ar_pln is not sizeof(struct in_addr) in in_arpinput().

cna.title: Quarkus-hibernate-orm-rest-data-panache: quarkus-hibernate-orm-rest-data-panache: information disclosure and dos via unvalidated sort parameter in rest data panache

descriptions.value: Quarkus REST Data Panache provides a way to automatically generate REST endpoints for data entities. A flaw was found where certain endpoints do not properly check the sort parameter provided by users. This could allow an attacker to learn information they should not have access to or slow down the system by forcing the database to perform complex tasks, potentially causing a denial of service.

A buffer overflow vulnerability in HPE NonStop TELSERV can cause memory corruption and DoS.

descriptions.value: Wheels CLI through 4.1.0 does not verify that the local development server answering its HTTP requests belongs to the current project. A process listening on a port targeted by the CLI can receive the project's reload password and code submitted through wheels reload or wheels console; console also probes common ports when the project server is down. Other commands can perform unintended state-changing operations against a different local application's server and database. Exploitation requires a process listening on a targeted local port and the developer running an affected command. This is fixed in 4.1.1, including changes to the CLI and application template.

descriptions.description: CWE-923 Improper Restriction of Communication Channel to Intended Endpoints

descriptions.value: Netgate pfSense FRR package (pfSense-pkg-frr) 2.0.2_1 and source revision 2.1.2_1 contain an OS command injection vulnerability in the FRR status filter. An authenticated WebGUI user with only the page-status-frr privilege can supply a filter value that breaks out of a single-quoted sed expression into which escapeshellarg() output is concatenated. Shell command substitution is then evaluated by a popen() pipeline, allowing attacker-selected commands to execute as root. There are updated FRR packages for pfSense Plus 26.07/26.03.1 and CE 2.9.0/2.8.1.

descriptions.description: CWE-78 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

descriptions.value: Backdrop CMS Core 1.35.x before 1.35.2 and 1.34.x before 1.34.6 mishandles tokens. A token is a small placeholder string (like [node:title] or [user:name]) used to automatically insert dynamic data into text. A browser is provided for selecting tokens by type. The product doesn't sufficiently limit access to the types of tokens that are available in the token browser. The names of the individual tokens are adequately protected.

descriptions.description: CWE-669 Incorrect Resource Transfer Between Spheres

supportingMedia.value: Update your site to the most recent version of Backdrop core. Download available on the Backdrop CMS 1.35.2 release page. See the update instructions.

solutions.value: Update your site to the most recent version of Backdrop core. Download available on the  Backdrop CMS 1.35.2 release page https://github.com/backdrop/backdrop/releases/tag/1.35.2 . See the  update instructions https://docs.backdropcms.org/documentation/core-updates .

cna.title: Thirty bees through 1.7.0 Account Takeover via PasswordController Guest Checkout

descriptions.value: Thirty bees through 1.7.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in PasswordController::resolveCustomer() that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset registered customers' passwords using guest account tokens. Attackers can place a guest order with the victim's email, then use the guest secure key to reset and take over the victim's account when guest checkout is enabled.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Thirty bees through 1.7.0 Account Takeover via PasswordController Guest Checkout

cna.title: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.18.0 Unauthenticated Username Change via Login V1

descriptions.value: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.18.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the hosted Login V1 UI, where the change-username handler acts on the account bound to a login flow before any factor is verified. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a victim's login name and then post a new username to rename any active human user, including administrators, locking them out.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ZITADEL 3.0.0 before 4.18.0 Unauthenticated Username Change via Login V1

cna.title: Heym v0.0.5 before v0.0.113 Broken Access Control via Workflow Execution Tokens

descriptions.value: Heym v0.0.5 before v0.0.113 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows former collaborators to keep executing JWT-auth workflows by reusing scoped workflow:execute tokens after share removal. Attackers can mint a token with a TTL up to 10 years, which the owner cannot list or revoke, and repeatedly run the workflow consuming shared credentials.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Heym v0.0.5 before v0.0.113 Broken Access Control via Workflow Execution Tokens

cna.title: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 LDAP Filter Injection Authentication Bypass via Authorization Header

descriptions.value: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 contains an LDAP filter injection in ldap-authorization and ad-authorization modes because usernames are inserted unescaped into LDAP search filters and authentication only checks user existence. When REMOTE_USER is not forwarded, unauthenticated attackers can send a wildcard username via HTTP Basic Authorization (PHP_AUTH_USER) to match all users and groups and gain admin access.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 LDAP Filter Injection Authentication Bypass via Authorization Header

cna.title: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 Stored XSS via wireless sensor description

descriptions.value: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in includes/html/pages/device/wireless.inc.php, which echoes wireless sensor sensor_descr values, populated from SNMP DisplayString fields during discovery, into HTML without escaping. Attackers controlling a monitored device's SNMP agent can set values such as AI-AP-MIB::aiSSID to malicious JavaScript that executes when authenticated users view the device's Wireless tab, enabling session hijacking.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: LibreNMS before 26.9.0 Stored XSS via wireless sensor description

cna.title: Adminer before 6.1.1 RCE via UTF-8 BOM SQLite ATTACH Bypass

descriptions.value: Adminer before 6.1.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated SQLite users to bypass ATTACH and VACUUM INTO restrictions by prefixing statements with a UTF-8 byte-order mark. Attackers can attach a database file at a PHP-served path and create a table named with PHP code to execute it as the web server user.

descriptions.description: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Adminer before 6.1.1 RCE via UTF-8 BOM SQLite ATTACH Bypass

cna.title: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 Missing Authentication in revoke RPC Method

descriptions.value: SurrealDB from 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the revoke RPC method that allows low-privileged or unauthenticated callers to invalidate other users' refresh tokens without proof of possession. Attackers can obtain grant identifiers via ACCESS SHOW ALL with VIEWER permission or leaked tokens, then permanently revoke refresh tokens to force re-authentication.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: SurrealDB 3.0.0 before 3.3.0 Missing Authentication in revoke RPC Method

cna.title: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Field Permission Bypass via LIVE SELECT WHERE Clause

descriptions.value: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows record users to infer field values hidden by field-level SELECT permissions using LIVE SELECT WHERE predicates over $before or $after. Attackers can craft repeated predicates and observe whether notifications are delivered on CREATE, UPDATE, or DELETE to confirm or narrow restricted field values.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: SurrealDB before 3.3.0 Field Permission Bypass via LIVE SELECT WHERE Clause

cna.title: Network-AI before 5.15.2 CORS Origin Validation Error in MCP SSE Transport

descriptions.value: Network-AI (npm network-ai) before 5.15.2 contains an origin validation error in McpSseServer._handleRequest in lib/mcp-transport-sse.ts that reflects localhost Origins into Access-Control-Allow-Origin regardless of bind interface. When the server binds a non-loopback address, an attacker page with a localhost Origin visited by a victim can read unauthenticated endpoints like /health cross-origin.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Network-AI before 5.15.2 CORS Origin Validation Error in MCP SSE Transport

cna.title: Admidio 4.0.12 through 4.3.17 and 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 Reflected XSS via system/redirect.php

descriptions.value: Admidio 4.0.12 through 4.3.17 and 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in system/redirect.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject JavaScript via the url GET parameter, due to an incomplete fix for CVE-2021-43810. Attackers can craft a javascript: URL containing a decoy http:// segment that passes validation and executes script in the Admidio origin when victims click the redirect link.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Admidio 4.0.12 through 4.3.17 and 5.0.0 before 5.0.15 Reflected XSS via system/redirect.php

cna.title: Grav Guestbook before 0.5.2 Stored XSS via AJAX Pagination and Admin Views

descriptions.value: Grav Guestbook plugin before 0.5.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because its AJAX Load more and Admin Load all handlers insert stored author and message fields into the DOM as unescaped HTML via jQuery. Unauthenticated visitors can submit markup that executes in other visitors' browsers and, in versions 0.5.0 and 0.5.1, in administrator moderation sessions.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Grav Guestbook before 0.5.2 Stored XSS via AJAX Pagination and Admin Views

cna.title: Grav API Plugin before 1.0.36 Privilege Escalation via Scalar Access Grants

descriptions.value: Grav grav-plugin-api before 1.0.36 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows delegated user managers to obtain super-admin access by storing positive scalar admin or api parent grants. Attackers with api.users.write can edit account access maps or invitations so the inheriting permission resolver satisfies requireSuper checks, accessing super-only API endpoints.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Grav API Plugin before 1.0.36 Privilege Escalation via Scalar Access Grants

cna.title: Grav Login Plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 2FA Bypass via Profile Update Form

descriptions.value: Grav Login plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 contains an authentication bypass in processUserProfile(), which checks that the session user exists but not that a pending front-end 2FA session is fully authorized. Attackers with a victim's password who can publish a page form without an access rule can invoke update_user before completing 2FA to disable twofa_enabled and take over the account.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Grav Login Plugin 2.7.0 before 3.9.9 2FA Bypass via Profile Update Form

cna.title: Craft CMS 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 DOM XSS via returnUrl in 2FA Verification

descriptions.value: Craft CMS 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 contains a DOM-based cross-site scripting vulnerability in the control panel login and 2FA verification flow, where a user-controlled returnUrl accepting javascript: URLs is used in client-side navigation. Attackers can lure a 2FA-enabled victim into opening a crafted /admin/login?verify=1 URL between password submission and TOTP verification, executing JavaScript in the authenticated control panel with the victim's permissions.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Craft CMS 5.0.0 before 5.10.14 DOM XSS via returnUrl in 2FA Verification

cna.title: Parse Server 8.2.2 before 8.6.94 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.1-alpha.14 GraphQL Schema Disclosure via Persisted Queries

descriptions.value: Parse Server 8.2.2 before 8.6.94 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.1-alpha.14 applies its GraphQL introspection control only to operation text sent directly with a request, not to operations resolved from Apollo Server's automatic persisted query cache. Unauthenticated attackers holding the public Application Id and client key can replay an introspection query previously cached by a master or maintenance key client to retrieve the schema, including private class and field names.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Parse Server 8.2.2 before 8.6.94 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.1-alpha.14 GraphQL Schema Disclosure via Persisted Queries

cna.title: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 Denial of Service via Automation Recurrence Rules

descriptions.value: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the automation recurrence-rule validator, whose sub-daily frequency guard parses rule text more strictly than the calendar library that executes it. Users permitted to create automations can submit whitespace-folded rules (or, in 0.11.0, lowercase frequencies or omitted RRULE prefixes) that expand per-second synchronously, blocking the shared event loop for minutes per request and on every scheduler poll.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Open WebUI 0.11.0 before 0.11.4 Denial of Service via Automation Recurrence Rules

cna.title: Open WebUI 0.6.27 before 0.11.4 Session Token Disclosure via OAuth-Mode Connections

descriptions.value: Open WebUI from 0.6.27 before 0.11.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows destination servers to obtain user session cookies by receiving the full browser cookie jar on OAuth-mode connections. Operators of OpenAI-compatible connections, OpenAPI tool servers or terminal servers can capture forwarded session cookies from routine requests and replay them to hijack accounts, including administrators.

descriptions.description: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Open WebUI 0.6.27 before 0.11.4 Session Token Disclosure via OAuth-Mode Connections

cna.title: Open WebUI 0.9.6 before 0.11.4 Information Disclosure via Unscoped Directory ID

descriptions.value: Open WebUI from 0.9.6 before 0.11.4 contains an authorization flaw where the knowledge base file listing does not verify that a supplied directory_id belongs to the requested knowledge base. Users with read access to any knowledge base can supply a retained foreign directory UUID to GET /api/v1/knowledge/{id}/files. The returned breadcrumbs expose folder names, owner user ids and knowledge base ids of that directory and all its ancestors.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Open WebUI 0.9.6 before 0.11.4 Information Disclosure via Unscoped Directory ID

cna.title: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Undefined Behavior in INFO, JSON and YAML Encoders

descriptions.value: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 contains a type confusion flaw in the INFO, JSON and YAML encoders, where an internal method receives a pointer of an unexpected type when writing an image in a compressed format. An attacker who can cause such an image write can trigger a SIGABRT or SIGSEGV, crashing the process and causing denial of service.

descriptions.description: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick before 6.9.13-57 and 7.x before 7.1.2-32 Undefined Behavior in INFO, JSON and YAML Encoders

cna.title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 Policy Bypass via -script Operation

descriptions.value: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the -script operation due to missing checks on file descriptor handling. Attackers can use the -script operation to close file descriptors not opened by the current operation, circumventing configured security policies.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-32 Policy Bypass via -script Operation
